_meta.what: Lines of each captured start sequence that depend on the print in hand, and what the maker's own slicer writes in their place.
_meta.how_to_read: For each model and condition, every entry's 'find' lines occur exactly once in that model's start sequence and become its 'replace' lines. Trailing spaces are not significant. {max_print_z} is the print's height rounded up to a whole millimetre; {curr_bed_type} is the plate's name.

conditions.tall: the print is at least tall_from_mm high
conditions.other_plate: the plate is not the textured one
conditions.hot_bed: the bed is hotter than hot_bed_above for this model, on the textured plate
